aboutBody: I’m Luis, a software developer in Guatemala. I like figuring out how things work and testing what I learn, even if all I build is a small prototype.
I’m drawn to artificial intelligence and computer security. I’m also curious about what happens when these technologies become part of public services and who decides how they’re used.
